name: classpulse-ai
description: ClassPulse - explainable early-warning academic support dashboard (Innovators Conclave 2026)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
